who_sub: Night over the Caspian Sea. Flight AQ-271 Astana — Tbilisi vanished over the water with 214 people on board.
who_you: Tulpar is your ship. Orange, with the yellow bathyscaphe Nerpa at the stern. You are the captain. Three officers calculate and advise; you decide.
who_rival: Poseidon-2 is the rival. A black and red ship of a private company. It wants to lift the black box first and hide the recording. Its course is the red dashes, its target the red flag, its plan is in the intercepted telegram.
who_hills: Amber tracing-paper hills show where the box most likely is. The higher, the likelier. The gold pin is Dana's best spot.
who_goal: Goal. Find and lift the flight recorder before Poseidon, while the beacon still works. Start with the tags below or with “Accept advice”.
clue_fish: Captain, fishermen here. We saw a flash {dir} of the last signal.
clue_coast_col: We found a seat cushion. With the current, the box is somewhere in a north–south strip — we marked it on the chart.
clue_coast_row: We found a seat cushion. With the current, the box is somewhere in a west–east strip — we marked it on the chart.
coach1: Amber tracing-paper hills show where the box most likely lies. The higher the hill, the likelier. The orange ship is your Tulpar, the red cross is the plane's last signal.
coach2: Dana finds the likely spot, Erlan plots the course, Murat-aga watches the fuel. Hold B and a drawer with their advice slides out from below. Not sure — press “Accept advice”.
coach3: Click a place on the chart, then choose: sonar (cheap, hears everything around) or a dive (costly, one place, almost never wrong). Every tag shows the cost and the chance.
coach4: The intercepted telegram, the red dashes and the flag show where Poseidon-2 goes and where it will search. It moves while your hours run. Get there first.
coach5: Every action costs beacon hours and fuel. Run out of fuel and the ship gets towed to base — a whole day lost.
end_win_title: The black box of flight AQ-271 is on board
end_win_story: The recording of the last minutes is on its way to the investigators. The families of 214 passengers will learn what happened, and planes of this type will be checked before the next flight.
end_rival_story: The box was {at}. The company sealed the recording until the trial — the families will wait for years.
end_beacon_story: The beacon battery ran out. The box stayed somewhere {at}, and without a signal it is almost impossible to find.
lesson_sonar: Try the sonar: it is cheaper than a dive and tells you where to dive.
lesson_rival: Watch the red line: the rival shows in advance where it will search. You can get there first.
lesson_beacon: A sonar check costs only 2 hours and narrows the search at once. Dive where the hill is already high.
lesson_good: Good work: you listened first, then dived where the hill was highest.
